source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the line test. There is the line: brake test and after the checklist
line the inputs to be documented. The following graphic will support you in filling out the form correctly.

In the following graphic we show you the location of the inputs you will need to fill in during a docking test.

Please note that in a „LIGHT“ version all required input fields are white, the fields required in a „FULL“ version are green.

![inspection.png](Attachments/inspection.png)

As you can see in this graphic, the brake test line „Roller brake test“ contains a list of the types of brakes used, and below that list you can see 5 empty rows. Three lines are required in the “FULL” version.

> The bottom two lines (tyred brake left/right) are used to evaluate the parking brake and are only available in version “FULL”, in version “LIGHT” these fields
